# Wisdom of Solomon Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Wisdom 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/WIS_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** O God of the fathers and Lord of mercy, the [one] having-made all-things by your word,

**9:2** and by your Wisdom having-formed man, that he should-rule the creatures having-come-into-being by you,

**9:3** and govern the world in holiness and righteousness, and administer judgment in uprightness of soul —

**9:4** give to-me the Wisdom the [one] sitting-beside your thrones, and do-not reject me from among your children.

**9:5** For I am your servant and the son of your female-servant, a man weak and short-lived, and too-little in-the understanding of judgment and laws.

**9:6** For even if one is perfect among sons of men, without your Wisdom he shall be counted as nothing.

**9:7** You chose me king of your people and judge of your sons and daughters.

**9:8** You commanded [me] to build a sanctuary on your holy mountain, and an altar in the city of your tabernacling, a copy of the holy tabernacle which you prepared from-the beginning.

**9:9** And with-you is Wisdom, the [one] knowing your works and present when you were-making the world, and understanding what is pleasing in your eyes and what is right according-to your commandments.

**9:10** Send her from holy heavens and from the throne of your glory dispatch her, that being-present she may labor with me, and I may know what is pleasing to-you.

**9:11** For she knows all-things and understands, and she will guide me in my actions prudently, and she will guard me in her glory.

**9:12** And my works shall be acceptable, and I shall administer your people righteously, and I shall be worthy of the throne of my father.

**9:13** For what man will know the counsel of God? Or who will reason-out what the Lord wills?

**9:14** For the thoughts of mortals are timid, and our calculations uncertain.

**9:15** For a perishable body weighs-down the soul, and the earthen tent burdens the mind teeming-with-thoughts.

**9:16** And we scarcely guess at the things on earth, and what is at-hand we find with-toil; but the things in heavens, who has traced-out?

**9:17** And your counsel, who knew, unless you gave Wisdom and sent your holy Spirit from on-high?

**9:18** And so the paths of those on earth were made-straight, and men were-taught the things pleasing to-you, and by Wisdom they were-saved.
